as_told.title: Epstein emails about killing Pons-Fleischmann cold fusion

plain: According to Jesse Michels, the financier Jeffrey Epstein bragged in one of his emails that he had "killed Pons" years before. Michels takes this to mean the chemists Stanley Pons and Martin Fleischmann, who in 1989 claimed results in cold fusion, meaning nuclear fusion at room temperature, and if he is right it would mean Epstein helped bury that work. Michels raises it himself across several episodes, quoting the emails without saying where he read them, and once adds, crediting the journalist Whitney Webb and her book One Nation Under Blackmail, that Epstein sold a piece of software tied to Sandia National Laboratories, a US nuclear weapons lab, that siphoned off American nuclear secrets.
